recipes.name: Cheap & Easy Ramen Nori Chips
ingredients: Vegetable or olive oil, for brushing
2 packets ramen seasoning of your choice, from packaged ramen
instructions: Lightly brush both sides of each square of nori with vegetable oil and then lightly sprinkle both sides with the ramen seasoning.
Lay the seasoned sheets onto a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 4-5 minutes, or until very crispy.
Cool the chips on a cooling rack for 10 minutes and enjoy.
